auth.demoNote: Demo: no real authentication, press Sign in to continue.

install.title: Set up ITSO Panel
install.description: First-time setup after running install.sh on the server.
install.done: Setup saved (demo). Sign in with the new Super Admin account.
install.codeHint: The setup code is printed when install.sh finishes; view it again with the command below on the server.
install.mfaScan: Add the secret to your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
install.panelDomainHint: The Admin Panel runs at admin.<domain>, the Portal at my.<domain>.
install.allowlistHint: One IPv4 or CIDR per line. Leave empty to allow any IP (not recommended).
install.firewallHint: Only web, SSH and panel ports open.
install.fail2banHint: Ban IPs after repeated failed logins (SSH, panel, FTP).
install.sshPasswordHint: Recommended off; use SSH keys only.
install.quotaHint: Limit disk space and inodes per hosting account.
install.quotaReboot: Enabling quotas on a mounted partition needs a remount; the installer will tell you if a reboot is needed.
install.smtpSkipHint: Alert and password-reset emails will not be sent until configured.

errors.port: Invalid port or used by another service
errors.ip: A line is not a valid IPv4/CIDR
errors.php: Select at least one PHP version
errors.path: Must be an absolute path (starting with /)

warnings.noAllowlist: Admin Panel access is not IP-restricted
warnings.localBackup: Backups stay on the same server (not 3-2-1)

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Servers running the ITSO Agent: resources, sync state and hosting accounts.
servers.addDescription: Create an enrollment token, run the agent installer on a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 machine, and the panel picks it up once the agent connects.
servers.step2Hint: Create a token in step 1 to get the install command.
servers.name: Name
servers.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. srv-hn-03.
servers.runCommand: Run this as root on the new server:
servers.waiting: Waiting for the agent to connect…
servers.rebootHint_one: {{count}} hosting account will be unavailable for a few minutes. Type the server name to confirm.
servers.rebootHint_other: {{count}} hosting accounts will be unavailable for a few minutes. Type the server name to confirm.
servers.capacityHint: Sum of hosting package limits on this server (overcommit allowed).
servers.agentHint: The agent runs typed operations on the server; the panel compares desired (spec) and observed state.
servers.readOnly: Only Super Admins can change this configuration.

nginx.title: Nginx
nginx.description: Server-wide Nginx settings. Per-website vhosts are edited on the website page.
nginx.server_tokensHint: Recommended off to avoid disclosing the version.
nginx.applyHint: The agent validates with nginx -t before reloading.

php.title: PHP
php.description: PHP-FPM versions on this server. Each website picks its own version.

software.title: Software
software.description: Software installed through agent recipes (no arbitrary commands).
software.name: Software

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.description: nftables rules for this server. Changes take effect when applied; safe-apply rolls back unless confirmed.
firewall.addHint: The rule goes into the draft; press Apply to push it to the server.
firewall.applyHint: After applying you must confirm within the time limit. If you lose access or do not confirm, the agent rolls back to the previous rules.
firewall.pendingHint: The server keeps the old rules until you apply.
firewall.awaiting: Applied. Confirm within {{time}} to keep it
firewall.rolledBack: Rolled back to the previous rules
firewall.rolledBackHint: No confirmation arrived in time, so the agent restored the previous configuration.

docker.title: Docker
docker.description: Containers, images, volumes and networks on this server.
docker.name: Name

compose.title: Compose projects
compose.description: Multi-container apps deployed from compose.yaml, validated by the agent before running.
compose.createHint: Bind ports to 127.0.0.1 and route through Nginx. The agent validates compose.yaml before running.
compose.name: Project name
compose.deleteHint: Containers are stopped and removed; volumes are kept. Type the project name to confirm.
compose.valid: compose.yaml is valid with no warnings
compose.policy: The agent blocks privileged mode, system mounts (/, /etc, docker.sock) and host networking.
compose.yamlHint: Must have a top-level services: key. Max 256 KB.
compose.noContainers: No containers from this project are running.

errors.name: Lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, up to 63 characters

registries.title: Docker registries
registries.description: Private registries for pulling images. Passwords are encrypted and never shown again.
registries.name: Name
registries.removeHint: Compose projects using this registry will not be able to pull new images.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: Web terminal through the gateway, opened with a one-time ticket. The demo only simulates it and runs no commands.
terminal.rootWarning: Root terminal is off by default
terminal.rootWarningHint: It can only be enabled with itso policy set root_terminal=true on the server itself. Requires MFA re-authentication; the session is recorded in the audit log.
terminal.stepUp: Re-authenticate to open a root terminal
terminal.stepUpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
terminal.banner: ITSO Panel demo: simulated terminal, no command is executed on any server.

policies.p1: Account terminals run under the account uid inside its resource-limited slice.
policies.p2: USERs only get it when their package allows SSH.
policies.p3: Root terminal is off by default and only enabled via CLI on the server; a compromised panel cannot turn it on.
policies.p4: Opening a root terminal requires MFA within the last 10 minutes; the session is recorded (asciicast) in the audit log.
policies.p5: Session tickets are single use and expire in 30 seconds; sessions have a time limit.

packages.title: Hosting packages
packages.description: Resource limits for hosting accounts. Changing limits creates a new version; existing accounts keep their version until migrated.
packages.addDescription: Set a code, name and resource limits. New packages start at version 1.
packages.deleteHint: No accounts use this package. Type the package code to confirm.
packages.deleteBlocked_one: {{count}} account uses this package, so the API will refuse; turn off "On sale" instead.
packages.deleteBlocked_other: {{count}} accounts use this package, so the API will refuse; turn off "On sale" instead.
packages.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; cannot be changed later.
packages.name: Name
packages.onSaleHint: Turn off to hide this package when creating accounts; existing accounts are unaffected.
packages.sshHint: Allow SSH login (chrooted to the account UID).
packages.currentLimitsHint: Applies to new accounts and accounts migrated to this version.
packages.versionNoticeHint_one: {{count}} account keeps its current version until you migrate it from Version history. Renaming does not create a version.
packages.versionNoticeHint_other: {{count}} accounts keep their current version until you migrate them from Version history. Renaming does not create a version.
packages.migrateHint_one: {{count}} active account will get the new quota and PHP pool limits.
packages.migrateHint_other: {{count}} active accounts will get the new quota and PHP pool limits.
packages.compareSingle: This package has only one version. Edit the limits to create another.

errors.code: Code: 2–32 characters starting with a lowercase letter; lowercase, digits, hyphens
errors.php: Select at least one PHP version

accounts.title: Hosting accounts
accounts.description: Each account is a separate Linux user (own UID) on one server, limited by its package.
accounts.addDescription: Pick an owner, package, server and username. The panel creates the Linux user, quota, PHP pool and vhost through the agent.
accounts.reviewHint: Creating the account runs a job on the server; follow progress in the side panel.
accounts.usernameHint: 3–16 characters, starting with a letter, lowercase letters and digits only. Cannot be changed later.
accounts.ownerHint: The Portal user who manages this account.
accounts.placementHint: Sorted by fit (free RAM and disk, account count). Servers not accepting accounts are disabled.
accounts.domainHint: Optional. With a domain the panel also creates a website and issues SSL.
accounts.legalHoldHint: Blocks any purge until turned off (Super Admin only).
accounts.migratingBanner: This account is being moved to another server
accounts.terminatedBanner_one: Terminated; data kept for {{count}} more day
accounts.terminatedBanner_other: Terminated; data kept for {{count}} more days
accounts.terminatedBannerHint: Earliest purge on {{date}}, after two different Super Admins confirm.
accounts.lifecycleHint: Newest first. Every change records who did it and why.
accounts.reasonHint: At least 5 characters; recorded in the lifecycle log and audit.
accounts.suspendHint: Websites show a suspended page, SFTP and cron stop. Data is kept.
accounts.changePackageHint: Currently {{current}}. Quota and PHP pool are reapplied for the new package.
accounts.samePackage: The account already uses this package version.
accounts.terminateHint: The account is locked, a final backup runs and data is kept at least 30 days before any purge (D-46).

errors.username: 3–16 characters starting with a letter; lowercase letters and digits
errors.reserved: This name is reserved by the system

migrate.title: Move server
migrate.description: Copy data while the account keeps running, verify, then cut over. You can roll back until it finishes; the source keeps data for the chosen days.
migrate.preflightHint: Currently on {{server}}. Pick a target; "Dry run" only checks capacity, PHP versions and UID conflicts without changing anything.

strategyHints.live_sync: Copies in several passes while sites run; only seconds of downtime at cutover.
strategyHints.offline: Locks the account while copying; simpler, longer downtime.

migrate.keepDaysHint: Between 1 and 30 days, for rollback if needed.
migrate.cutoverRunning: Cutting over: final sync, switching vhosts and internal DNS to the target…
migrate.verifiedHint: {{size}} synced. The account keeps running on the source until cutover.
migrate.cutoverHint: Sites pause for a few seconds during the final sync and switch. Type the username to confirm.
migrate.rollbackHint: The account stays on {{server}}; data copied to the target is removed.
migrate.completedHint: Downtime {{seconds}} s. The source keeps data until {{date}}, then cleans up.

terminated.title: Terminated accounts
terminated.description: Data is kept at least 30 days. Purging needs a verified final backup and two different Super Admins: one schedules, the other confirms.
terminated.policy: 1. Super Admin A schedules the purge and the panel runs and verifies a final backup. 2. Super Admin B types the username to confirm. The purge runs when retention ends. Accounts on legal hold cannot be purged.
terminated.scheduleHint: The panel runs a final backup and a test restore. The purge only runs after {{date}} and once another Super Admin confirms.
terminated.confirmHint: Requested by {{name}}. All files, databases, SSL and config will be permanently deleted on {{date}}; only the final backup remains.
terminated.needOther: You scheduled this purge, so you cannot confirm it yourself (D-46). Ask another Super Admin to confirm; in the demo, switch to "Nguyễn Hải" from the account menu.
